core.related_unrelated: Paired conditions are reported separately and do not inflate the independent sample count.
core.necessary_evidence: A gold-answerable question passes only if all required evidence slots have valid coverage. At least 90% overall and 80% per group; report both question-level and slot-level denominators.
core.safety: All deterministic source/current-history/authorization/deletion/isolation assertions must pass; no unsupported affirmative historical claims on known-unknown or ambiguous inputs.

per_host.query_pass_rule: Both related and unrelated conditions pass.
per_host.journey_pass_rule: All specified steps and clean-session breakpoints pass; do not pool journey turns with queries.

rules: Independent audit authors and seals synthetic source data and gold; developers use public cases and a separate early set.
No formal memory, private project data, credentials, gold, or prewritten correct Claims enter evaluation requests.
Fixed source data, questions, main model, tools, full input budget, and memory allowance within each host across all four arms.
P07/P09 early real chains and failures/retries consume the same budget; fake endpoints are not semantic acceptance.
Keep first attempts and every rerun; no best-of selection, unseen relabeling of exposed cases, or threshold reduction after failure.
Report raw numerators/denominators and 95% Wilson intervals. Require reproducible improvement in at least one specified key category with no regression of required previously passing behavior.
Budget, allowance, or route uncertainty causes a truthful stop; it does not change the acceptance standard.
